question: Does richer candidate-specific canonical-derived task evidence resolve hard adjacent-role negatives better than the frozen v0 compact evidence without increasing target drops?

retrieval_boundary.purpose: candidate-relevance mechanism test only; not a new retrieval architecture

hard_confusion_population.source_contract: public canonical v31 label/definition/alternative labels only
hard_confusion_population.caveat: Task atoms are model-derived architecture evidence from canonical source text, not independent taxonomy truth.

query_evaluation.reason_for_year: new independent v1 evaluation year; 2023/2024 were already used by earlier display calibration/oracle work

candidate_protocol.candidate_set: the fixed two concepts of the corresponding pre-existing hard-confusion pair
candidate_protocol.candidate_order: deterministically shuffled by case key and protocol version
candidate_protocol.drop_semantics: only clearly semantically irrelevant according to supplied evidence
candidate_protocol.uncertain_policy: retained; insufficient evidence is not a drop

oracle.prompt_rule: reuse the frozen conservative v0 keep/uncertain/drop instructions unchanged

control_evidence.contract: canonical label <=12 words; <=3 alternative labels <=12 words; definition <=50 words; <=2 already-frozen A593 task/teacher phrases <=24 words
control_evidence.purpose: reproduce the evidence density of semantic display oracle v0 on the same independent hard-confusion cases

challenger_evidence.contract: same canonical label/alternative-label/definition limits as control plus all six pre-existing canonical-derived task atoms for the candidate, each clipped to <=24 words

metrics.target_non_drop_retention: fraction of structured-target candidates judged keep or uncertain
metrics.hard_negative_drop_rate: fraction of paired non-target candidates judged drop
metrics.uncertain_rate: reported for target and paired negative separately
metrics.pair_level_negative_drop_rate: reported for every eligible fixed pair

decision_gate.sample_valid: at least 40 cases across at least 8 of the 11 fixed pairs
decision_gate.target_safety: challenger target non-drop retention >= 0.98 and no more than one additional target drop versus control
decision_gate.hard_negative_materiality: challenger paired hard-negative drop rate improves by >= 0.10 absolute over control
decision_gate.if_pass: freeze v1 evidence contract; only then replay exact unchanged opened stress as falsifier
decision_gate.if_fail: do not replay opened, do not distill, and do not tune from opened; reassess evidence provenance/interaction
